items.title: Sin Stock Investing: Finding Opportunities in Controversial Industries
items.summary: Sin stocks can offer resilient demand and strong cash generation, but regulation, legal risks and shifting social attitudes remain key considerations. Sin stocks span tobacco, alcohol, gambling and defense.

items.title: Philip Morris International (PM) Lifts Quarterly Dividend 8.8% To $6.40 Annualized
items.summary: Philip Morris International (NYSE: PM) announced a significant increase in its regular quarterly dividend on 21 September 2026. The revised payout applies to the upcoming dividend cycle, affecting shareholders of record as of the next declared date. Management described the higher dividend as aligned with the board's view of the business's cash generation and financial position. This larger regular quarterly dividend is important to weigh alongside the rest of our analysis on Philip Morris...

items.title: This High-Yield Tobacco Stock Just Raised Its Dividend by 8.8%
items.summary: Philip Morris International raised its quarterly dividend by 8.8% to $1.60 per share, lifting the annual payout to $6.40 after smoke-free products accounted for about 42% of sales.

items.title: Can Altria's on! Build Share as Nicotine Pouches Keep Growing?
items.summary: MO expands its nicotine pouch presence as the category reshapes the U.S. oral tobacco market and on! PLUS broadens nationwide retail reach.

items.title: Tobacco Stock Drops After New CEO and Guidance Cut Announcement
items.summary: Turning Point Brands  named a new CEO and cut its full-year outlook on Monday.  Altria Group  shares dropped 1.4%, and  Philip Morris International  stock fell 1% on the news.  London-traded  British American Tobacco  shares declined 0.5%.

items.title: Philip Morris Raises Dividend, Reinforces Growth Strategy
items.summary: PM has raised its quarterly dividend by 8.8%, underscoring growth through smoke-free products, cost savings and strong brands.
